consequence.statement: This bugfix accepts a 'v'-prefixed Bottlerocket alias that was not allowed before. Nothing in an existing configuration stops working.

original.statement: Karpenter 1.0.0 fixes a bug so that Bottlerocket aliases can now use a "v" prefix.

decision.reason: [ev-089778a9e2c3] lists this under Bug Fixes and says only that a 'v' prefix is now allowed for Bottlerocket aliases. That loosens what is accepted. Nothing in the evidence says that any existing alias form is rejected, ignored or fails, so a failure kind or behavior-change is not supported. "none" (informational) fits best, but it is inferred from the word "allow" rather than stated outright, so confidence is low.
